text:
Ava: During the quarterly access review I noticed the role `ci-runner-admin` still has `kms:Decrypt` on `*`. That seems broader than intended for our CI runners.
Ruben: Oof. Which key ARNs or policies show that?
Ava: Pulled the role policy and KMS grants. Snippet below: 
```json
{
  "RoleName": "ci-runner-admin",
  "Policy": [{"Effect": "Allow", "Action": "kms:Decrypt", "Resource": "*"}]
}
```
Ava: And KMS:ListGrants shows multiple grants referencing the role principal, no owner tag on the grants.
sec-bot: Auto-detected risky grant: prod-usw2 key id abc1... risk level HIGH. Created ticket SEC-8713 and pager note to oncall.
Lia: Immediate mitigation idea: add a deny statement scoped to principals outside `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci-runner-*` and add a KeyPolicy condition like `StringEquals: {aws:PrincipalArn: "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci-runner-*"}`.
Sam: I prefer restricting on both principal and request context. Example KMS key policy change: 
```json
{
  "Sid": "LimitCIUsage",
  "Effect": "Deny",
  "Principal": "*",
  "Action": "kms:*",
  "Resource": "*",
  "Condition": {"StringNotLike": {"aws:PrincipalArn": ["arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci-runner-*"]}}
}
```
Sam: We'll apply as a temporary guard and roll a narrower allow after owners confirm.
Ruben: Also we should harden the CI role instead: split admin into `ci-secrets-reader` with explicit key ARNs and reduce EC2 instance profile scope.
Ava: Agreed. For the audit side, can we bump KMS event retention in CloudTrail for 180d and add a metric filter for `Decrypt` calls from CI principals?
Lia: Yes. I'll create an Owens runbook entry and dashboard: `Security -> KMS / CI decrypts`. Alert to #eng-security if Decrypt spikes or a Decrypt from unexpected principal appears.
sec-bot: Note: onboarding checklist updated: new requirement to tag key grants with `owner` and `purpose`. Failing grants will auto-flag during weekly scan.
Sam: Operational plan: (1) apply temporary key policy deny (2) open sprint task to split role + update infra templates (3) outreach to teams holding grants with 72h owner window (4) enforce owner tag via pre-commit hook on infra repo.
Ava: I'll open the outreach message and paste it here; also linking the remediation runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-ci-hardening.
Ruben: Assigning tasks: Sam -> temporary key policy deploy (PR #1310), Lia -> CloudTrail metric/dashboard (PR #1311), Ava -> outreach and role-split proposal (issue-2456).
Ava: Update: temporary policy applied in prod-usw2 in dry-run mode first, no failures in 10m. Going to monitor for 2h then flip to enforce if stable.
Lia: Thanks. Great example of least-privilege audit catching drift.
Ruben: Follow-up: add a lint rule in `infra-templates` to reject kms:Decrypt on "*" in role policies (pre-commit check).
Ava: Filing follow-up ticket for lint rule: SEC-8714.
sec-bot: SEC-8713 updated: status=mitigating, artifacts=[PR#1310,PR#1311,issue-2456].
Sam: Closing loop — will post post-mortem note in access-review doc with lessons and a checklist so this doesn't recur.
Ava: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
